| description = Generally found underwater, such as the underwater tower in the [[Oasis of Marr]] or in the tunnel under [[Lake Rathetear]]. They are hostile and like to nuke with [[Winter's Roar]] or [[Thunder Strike]], besides sometimes casting [[Scourge]], [[Listless Power]], [[Tagar's Insects]], [[Envenomed Breath]] and very rarely [[Blinding Luminance]]. They will also shoot their targets with arrows for approx. 26 damage (despite being shamans).
